claims.value: MolmoMotion-4B-H1-F32 is a 4B parameter autoregressive vision-language model that forecasts 3D point trajectories given a single RGB observation keyframe, 2D query points, and natural language action instructions.
claims.evidence: MolmoMotion is a 4B vision-language model that forecasts 3D point trajectories under natural-language action instructions. This checkpoint is the autoregressive (AR) variant with history H=1.
Given a short RGB observation history... and an action description, it predicts where those points move in 3D... pipeline_tag: image-text-to-text
This checkpoint is the autoregressive (AR) variant with history H=1 and future horizon F=32.
